name: pdfz-mobile
description: PDFz per Android e iPhone: interfaccia + motore Python (Pyodide) dentro l'app, funziona offline
author: agjin

scripts.build: npm run web && npm run engine && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run build && cd android && (gradlew.bat assembleDebug || ./gradlew assembleDebug)
scripts.build:ios: npm run web:ios && npm run engine && npx cap sync ios
